welcome.subject: Order received — we're on it
welcome.preview: Thanks for your order. Track everything in real time.
welcome.body:
Thanks for your order! 🥳

Your order has been received and registered.

It will take about 48 hours to produce your order, pack it, and hand it to the courier. We'll let you know as soon as it's ready to ship and send you the tracking code.

In the meantime, here are three ways to follow everything:

channels.after: — I answer any questions about your order.

abandoned_cart.subject: You left something in your cart
abandoned_cart.preview: Made to order — spots don't last.
abandoned_cart.heading: Still there?
abandoned_cart.body: You left some items in your cart. I produce to order: when a batch is done, it's done. If you're still interested, sooner is better.
abandoned_cart.footer_note: Handcrafted production — every sheet is one of a kind.

review_request.subject: How did it arrive?
review_request.preview: Your order arrived a few days ago.
review_request.heading: Let me know.
review_request.body: Your order arrived a few days ago. Have you tried tattooing on it yet? Every bit of feedback helps me improve the next batch — just reply to this email.

reengagement.subject: Still here.
reengagement.heading: Don't disappear.
reengagement.body: It's been a while. Whenever you're ready to order again, I'm here — in the meantime I keep producing and improving.

pwa_invite.subject: Your personal space is waiting
pwa_invite.preview: Track your order and discover your exclusive offer.
pwa_invite.heading: Your order is being made.
pwa_invite.body: You have a personal area on thefoolishbutcher.com where you can track your order in real time, download your files, and find a small surprise just for you.
pwa_invite.pwa_hint: You can also install the app on your phone — tap 'Add to Home Screen' from your browser.

footer.unsubscribe_text: Don't want to receive emails anymore?
